name: Siddharta Govindaraj
tagline: AI Trainer, Consultant, Python Geek, Author
about: Agentic coding is revolutionising software development. The mythical 10x programmer is now within everyone's grasp. Today, a single team of three engineers can be more productive than a team of twenty from five years ago. Interested in getting there for yourself or your team? Let's talk! Hi, I'm Siddharta, and I've been working on making programmers 10x more productive for the last fifteen years. I started my consulting with technical agility, test driven development, clean code, and devops pipelines. I then transitioned to Python, Javascript, and training the full stack developer. Today I work with teams to incorporate agentic coding practices. The 10x programmer is now withing everyone's reach. Let's find out how.

item.title: Agentic Coding Consultant
item.text: A lot of people confuse agentic coding with AI slop. And they are not wrong - that is what it is when it is vibe coded. Agentic engineering, on the other hand, is high quality, precisely engineered code. There is a process for it and that's what I teach

item.title: Gen AI Trainer
item.text: Learn to harness generative AI to solve problems. Build bots, agents and orchestrations to automate hard parts of your organisational workflows. Building AI powered applications is easy in demos buy complex to get right in production. Harvard says 80% of enterprise AI deployments fail. What does it take to be in the 20%?

item.title: Full Stack Consultant
item.text: Full stack knowledge is challenging. The engineer needs to know the equivalent of three regular engineers. But the outcome from a full stack engineer is incredible. Features that used to take weeks as they handed-off between multiple teams can now bo completed by a small team without any handoffs.

item.title: Technical Agile Coach
item.text: The bedrock of being able to do quick delivery is to have solid technical practices to enable it. Test driven development, clean code, continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines. Add to that development practices that encourage iterative development, small features delivered frequently, measuring the data and making changes.

testimonial.quote: Siddharta (Sid) and I worked together for couple of years. He occurred to me as one of the coolest, driven, hands-on coach that people actually loved to work with (not easy for an agile coach :). His ability to effortlessly connect with varied audience - from interns to VPs was extremely powerful. Sid and I closely worked together on two key agile initiatives - an interactive session with engineering managers on defining and refining their role in agile work culture and a technical excellence summit with a wider engineering community - for them, by them (i.e. engineers crowdsourced problem statements and did live solutioning). Sid is an amazing person to work with and would be an asset to any organisation (small or big) looking for agile adoption.
